faq_heading: Questions B2B teams ask about getting more LinkedIn responses

faqs.q: Why am I getting no responses on LinkedIn outreach?
faqs.a: The usual causes are a list that does not match your buyer, a message that talks about you instead of them, no follow-up and slow replies. Fix targeting first, then the message, then the follow-up rhythm.

faqs.q: Should I send a note with my connection request?
faqs.a: Often a short note with one real reason to connect works better than a pitch. Keep it to two or three lines and save the offer for after they accept.

faqs.q: How many follow-ups should I send?
faqs.a: Two or three polite follow-ups, spaced several days apart, then stop. Stop at once when someone replies, even with a no.

faqs.q: What counts as a good response?
faqs.a: Count replies from real buyers, not just acceptances. Track people reached, acceptances, real replies and booked calls, and judge them over a full month.

faqs.q: Can an AI agent improve my response rate?
faqs.a: It can help by keeping the list tight, personalising each note from facts you approve and following up on schedule. It cannot fix an unclear offer, so write that first.
